subject: Acme security integration: BYOK + audit export + SSO mapping — triage
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme security integration: BYOK + audit export + SSO mapping — triage

Team —

Acme (contracting for Dedicated) surfaced three blocking items in their last call:

1) BYOK: they require customer-controlled keys (imported KMS key or equivalent) with key rotation logs retained for 7 years. They asked whether Redwood can support an imported/managed key and whether HSM-backed keys are required for their compliance.

2) Audit export: they want continuous streaming of audit logs (auth events, model access, admin actions) to their S3 bucket in near-real-time, plus a daily aggregated CSV for longer-term ingestion. They asked about retention guarantees and whether we can include post-incident forensics packages.

3) SSO & provisioning: they need SCIM sync and attribute mapping for role enforcement. They also need user->project mappings preserved in logs for compliance.

Can each of you confirm the feasibility and what we need to surface to the customer (exceptions, timeline, or temporary compensating controls)? Please call out: gaps, required security reviews, and rough engineering effort (S, M, L). I want a short list we can send to Alex with a proposed sequence and dates.

I attached the customer's requirements doc from the call (acme_kms_requirements.pdf).

Thanks —
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme security integration: BYOK + audit export + SSO mapping — triage

Karthik —

Quick answers / blockers from security:

- BYOK: We can support customer-managed keys, but we need clarity on two things: (a) will the key be AWS KMS imported key vs. external HSM? We currently support AWS KMS CMKs with restrictive key policy; imported key material is OK but will require a security review and updated key policy templates. Effort: M (policy + compliance review) + S from infra to wire KMS IAM guards.

- HSM: If customer demands FIPS 140-2 Level 3 or dedicated HSM appliance we may need a Private deployment with HSM integration. That is a separate product conversation and likely L effort.

- Long-term retention (7 years): Our retention model allows configurable retention for audit logs in Dedicated/Private; Hosted has 90/365 defaults. For 7-year retention we need to confirm storage SLA and export pipeline to their S3 with lifecycle rules. Effort: M. Also need sign-off from Legal on data residency + retention.

- Audit export formatting: We need field-level agreement on the schema (events, actor_id, project_id, token_id, ip, user_agent, request_id). If they require immutable WORM storage, that's an additional requirement.

- SSO/SCIM: We support SCIM v2 and attribute mapping but don't yet persist project-level mappings in audit logs by default; that's an engineering change (S).

Action items for me:
- I'll prepare security checklist + required artifacts (SOC2 pages, pen-test summary).
- I need a short tech spec from infra (Vivek) on how BYOK would be mounted and what the KMS key policy should look like.

-Neha
Director, Security & Compliance

Adding engineering detail and a proposed phasing:

Summary of feasibility:
- BYOK (AWS KMS CMK import): feasible in Dedicated and Private. For Hosted, we'd need a per-tenant KMS integration path (currently gated). Implementation requires key policy templates + a KMS role binding flow. Effort estimate: M (4–6 wks) to implement secure onboarding + CI/CD changes for key rotation hooks.

- Audit export streaming to customer S3: already supported as an opt-in export for some partners, but not the exact near-real-time stream with guaranteed ordering. Option A: Firehose-based streaming with best-effort delivery (S-M effort, 2–3 wks). Option B: Stronger guarantee with an append-only log service and daily integrity manifests (M-L, 6–8 wks).

- SCIM + project attribute mapping in logs: small schema change + SCIM attribute mapping config. Effort: S (1–2 wks) to add project_id to auth events.

Constraints / risk:
- BYOK onboarding requires a security runbook for key compromise, escrow policies, and a tested key rotation path. We should avoid storing plain key material in our control plane; prefer customer-controlled keys.
- Audit export with forensic packages needs storage and indexing considerations; we should scope initial rollout to streaming + daily aggregates, then add forensic bundles as an optional premium feature.

Proposed phase plan (dates are rough):
Phase 0 (Discovery) — 1 week: Confirm exact key type, S3 bucket policies, and SCIM attribute list. (Owner: Karthik)
Phase 1 (Minimum viable) — 3 weeks: SCIM mapping + add project_id to logs; enable Firehose stream to their S3; prepare KMS key policy template. (Owner: Engineering + Security)
Phase 2 (Harden) — 4–6 weeks: Implement secure BYOK onboarding flow + rotation hooks + legal checklist. (Owner: Infra + Security)
Phase 3 (Forensics & long retention) — 6–8 weeks: Append-only manifests, WORM support, long-term retention pipelines. (Owner: Infra + Product)

I'll draft a one-pager with the opt-in features and estimated dates. Needs Neha and Legal sign-off before we share timelines externally.

—Vivek
VP, Infrastructure Engineering

Great breakdown. Commercial notes to be aware of for the customer:

- BYOK/hardening: this is likely to be a lift that moves them from standard Hosted pricing to a Dedicated or Private engagement. We should prepare an options matrix (Hosted w/ compensating controls vs Dedicated w/ BYOK).
- 7-year retention for logs: will require a separate storage billing line item; propose we price this as x$/GB/year with a minimum commit.
- SLA expectations: they asked for near-real-time exports and forensic packages; we should set expectations (best-effort streaming initially, formal SLA for forensic delivery only after Phase 3).

I'll draft the commercial options and a short email to Acme that maps our Phase plan to costs and asks them to confirm the key type and S3 bucket details.

-LB
Account Executive

Alex —

Following internal triage, here is a short, actionable plan and a request list so we can align on scope and timelines. Please review and confirm the items below so we can scope work and share committed dates.

Summary (short):
- We can support BYOK for Dedicated/Private. For Hosted customers we will need an opt-in integration path; please confirm if Acme requires Hosted (multi-tenant) or Dedicated.
- We can stream audit events to your S3 via Firehose as an initial approach; durable WORM/forensic bundles are a separate phase.
- SCIM is supported; we need the final attribute map for project -> role mapping so we persist project_id in logs.

Requested from Acme:
1) Confirm deployment preference: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (impacts timeline).
2) Confirm KMS type: AWS KMS CMK (imported key material) vs external HSM. If AWS KMS, please provide the target account id and desired key alias.
3) Provide S3 bucket name, preferred region, and any bucket policy constraints.
4) Share SCIM attribute mapping CSV (I attached an example: sso-mapping-sample.csv).

Attachments: acme_kms_requirements.pdf, redwood-proposed-rollout-plan.xlsx, sso-mapping-sample.csv

We'd like to run Phase 0 discovery next week if that's possible.

Thanks —
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
